INCIDENT REPORT — CASE # 2024-78901

Prepared by: Officer Sarah Mitchell
Date of Report: April 2, 2024
Agency: Springfield Police Department

========================================================================
SECTION 1: INCIDENT DETAILS
========================================================================

Date of Incident: March 15, 2024
Time: Approximately 14:30 hours
Location: 1247 Oak Street, Springfield
Incident Type: Traffic Collision / Hit and Run

On March 15, 2024, at approximately 2:30 PM, officers were dispatched
to 1247 Oak Street regarding a reported hit and run incident. Upon
arrival, Officer Mitchell observed a 2022 Honda Civic (license plate
ABC-1234) with significant rear-end damage. The vehicle was unoccupied.

Witness Mrs. Eleanor Thompson, a resident at 1245 Oak Street, reported
that she heard a loud crash at approximately 14:25 hours and observed
a dark-colored pickup truck fleeing the scene northbound on Oak Street.
Mrs. Thompson stated she saw the driver, described as a male in his 30s
wearing a red jacket.

The registered owner of the Honda Civic, Mr. James Wilson, arrived at
the scene at 15:00 hours and provided his statement. Mr. Wilson stated
he had parked his vehicle at 12:30 PM and was inside his place of
employment at the time of the incident.

=======================================================================
SECTION 2: INVESTIGATION
=======================================================================

On March 16, 2024, Detective Thomas Reed was assigned to the case.
He conducted a neighborhood canvas of Oak Street. Surveillance footage
from 1247 Oak Street was collected, covering the time period from
14:00 to 15:00 hours on March 15, 2024.

2024-03-18: Detective Reed identified a suspect vehicle, a 2019 Ford
F-150 (license plate XYZ-5678), matching the description provided by
the witness. The vehicle was registered to Mr. Robert Johnson of 832
Elm Street.

On 03/20/2024, Detective Reed interviewed Mr. Robert Johnson at the
Springfield Police Department. Mr. Johnson admitted to being at the
scene but claimed he left before the collision occurred. He stated he
was driving on Oak Street at approximately 14:20 hours and observed
a parked Honda Civic but did not strike it.

2024-03-25: Detective Reed submitted a request for traffic camera
footage from the intersection of Oak Street and Main Street for the
period of 14:00 to 15:00 on March 15, 2024.

=======================================================================
SECTION 3: FORENSIC ANALYSIS
=======================================================================

On March 28, 2024, the SPD Forensic Unit examined the paint transfer
on the Honda Civic. Forensic Analyst Dr. Patricia Chen determined that
the paint fragments recovered from the damaged area matched the paint
code of the 2019 Ford F-150 model.

03/30/2024: A search warrant was executed at 832 Elm Street. Officers
seized the 2019 Ford F-150 for further forensic examination. Paint
samples were collected from the front bumper area.

April 2, 2024: Case file was submitted to the District Attorney's
Office for review. Charges pending: Hit and Run (VC 20002), Reckless
Driving (VC 23103).

=======================================================================
SECTION 4: PARTIES INVOLVED
=======================================================================

Victim/Witness List:
- James Wilson (victim) — 456 Pine Avenue, Springfield
    2024 Honda Civic owner. No injuries reported.
- Eleanor Thompson (witness) — 1245 Oak Street, Springfield
    78 years old. Reliable witness.
- Officer Sarah Mitchell — SPD Badge #4521
    First responding officer.
- Detective Thomas Reed — SPD Detective Division
    Lead investigator, assigned 03/16/2024.
- Dr. Patricia Chen — SPD Forensic Lab
    Paint analysis, report dated 03/28/2024.

Suspect: Robert Johnson — 832 Elm Street, Springfield
    2019 Ford F-150 owner. Interviewed 03/20/2024.

=======================================================================
END OF REPORT
